DATA:
Categories (States) and values (Percentage of Companies Scoring 100):
- Maryland: 67

KEY FACTS:
- Maryland has the highest percentage of companies scoring 100 on the Corporate Equality Index at 67%.
- Massachusetts follows closely behind in second place with 65%.
- Connecticut and Kentucky tie for the lowest percentage among the top ten states listed, both at 43%.
- New York and Washington share the same percentage at 53%.
